question: What statistical test would be applied to compare two eye drops administering a different one in each eye of the same patient ?:

options.opa: Student's t test of independent samples.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Two eye drops administering a different one in each eye of the same patient" -> "Paired design" -> "McNemar test" -> 95% CHAIN: "Two eye drops administering a different one in each eye of the same patient" -> "Continuous outcome measure" -> "Student's t test of independent samples" -> 90% CHAIN: "Two eye drops administering a different one in each eye of the same patient" -> "Unequal variances between groups" -> "Welch's t-test" -> 95%
